title: Factor
description: A factor is a number that divides another number exactly without leaving any remainder.
note: Every number has at least two factors: 1 and itself.

title: Multiple
description: A multiple is obtained by multiplying a number by a whole number.

example.question: Write the first five multiples of 7.

note: Every number has infinitely many multiples.

title: Number of Factors
description: If n = pᵃqᵇrᶜ..., then the total number of factors equals (a+1)(b+1)(c+1)...

example.question: Find the number of factors of 72.

note: Use prime factorization before applying the formula.

title: Sum of Factors
description: For a prime power pⁿ, the sum of its factors is (pⁿ⁺¹−1)/(p−1). For multiple prime factors, multiply the individual sums.

example.question: Find the sum of factors of 8.

title: Greatest Factor
description: The greatest factor of any number is the number itself.
note: Every number is divisible by itself.

title: Smallest Factor
description: The smallest factor of every natural number is 1.
note: 1 is a factor of every natural number.
